- The Tactical Bot now reliably continues to its next turn after finishing a background search, even when nobody has the game window open.
- Players can now resign from a game while a choice like Compulsion or Suspicion is waiting specifically on them.
- Bots no longer target Hope or Grace with Pacifism or Scorn, since suppressing either card does nothing at all -- they'll now suppress a real threat instead.
- Weekly Sealed Pool standings now give tied players the same rank (e.g. two players tied 1-0 both rank #1, with the next distinct record at #3, not #2).
